conclusion.statement: With region attention now always driven by the predicted centre/radius, the ellipsoid occupancy does change the forward model (initial objective shifts by up to 0.128 relative; the node set changes in 12/18 scenes at aspect 1.5 and 16/18 at aspect 2.0), but the E_background estimate is bitwise identical to the unperturbed baseline in 18/18 (aspect 1.5) and 18/18 (aspect 2.0) scenes, acceptance is identical in 18/18, and all three medians equal the baseline. On the 256-node patch the predicted sphere covers 0-10 nodes and the ellipsoid adds 0-8 nodes; with the inclusion ratio locked this perturbation is too small to move the discrete E/q search endpoint. The arm therefore reports a null effect by construction and should not be cited as evidence of robustness to inclusion shape; it is informative only as a check that the fixed region-attention path reproduces the baseline (objective differs only at the 1e-15 level in scenes whose node set is unchanged).
conclusion.archived_defective_arms: results/ct_reviewer_drivers_v6/assumption_sensitivity/aspect_{1p5,2p0} let fit_patient fall back to the ground-truth centre/radius for region attention (inclusion_center/radius were None when soft_occupancy was given). Their E estimates differed from baseline in 1/18 scenes (geom_ab578f1bb0ee02be2ccd_scenario_001) and their objectives differed from baseline at the 1e-5 level even where the node set was unchanged; the fixed arms remove both effects.

notes: Run settings: experiments/run_screened_fem_locked.py --cohort ct120 --prior-width-scale 2.0 --screen-threshold 0.05 --probe-count 2 --max-nfev 48 --region-aspect-xy {1.5,2.0} --patient-ids <18 locked ids>; OMP_NUM_THREADS=3, run 2026-10-12.
